title: The Nil K-groups of finite groups
summary: We show that for every finite group $G$ and every integer $n$, the Nil group $\mathrm{NK}_n(\mathbb{Z}[G])$ of the integral group ring of $G$ has finite exponent, and give a bound depending on n and the order $|G|$. This bound is explicit when every prime divisor of $|G|$ is at least $3+n/2$. More generally, our finite exponent result applies to $\mathrm{NK}_n(R[G])$ whenever $R$ is a regular, torsion-free, Noetherian commutative ring such that $R/p$ is regular for every prime $p$ that divides $|G|$.
